metadata.subtitle: XVII. Fugue in A-flat major: Fuga, fuggendo la cadenza
metadata.composer: Claude / composed for Sam (guest subject: J. S. Bach, BWV 862)
metadata.instrument: Piano (four voices; a fifth, the father, at the end)

markers.label: The running gag: the bass steps up, faster and faster
The dream (E major): the subject in augmentation
At home: the trill that will not stop
... and again as an echo, pianissimo: the stretto starts under it
Fermata on the rest: silence (about 4 s)
